morning.caption:
Today is a Monkey day 🐒 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Monkey meets the animal of the year you were born: Snake gets a best-friend day, Rat and Dragon a team day, Tiger a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

evening.caption:
Sky has just arrived on Earth, and everything is new 🌙

Sky is the quiet Yin spirit. She doesn't rush in; she pauses, notices and feels her way. A golden hilltop, rolling hills, a sparkling river, then a cool breeze and one small raindrop landing in her hand. In people, this Yin side is the part of you that pauses to take in a new place before you decide what it means. The gentle start is often where the real discovery begins.

What's the first thing you notice when you arrive somewhere new? Tell us below 👇
